description: Everything that could not be confirmed from an official source, disagreed between sources, or needs a human decision. Nothing here blocks publication; each item is published on the 'Flagged for Review' page.

items.title: Gaelic football is not named in the exclusion list
items.detail: The brief excludes 'football', 'american football' and 'hurling' but never says Gaelic football. Gaelic football is a different sport from association football and from hurling, so it is included here, tagged ambiguous_exclusion=true on every row so the whole block can be dropped with one filter if that was not the intent.

items.title: Kick-off times on OLBG are not labelled with a timezone and are internally inconsistent
items.detail: OLBG prints only 'Today', 'Tomorrow' or a date plus a clock time, never a timezone. Comparing three sports in the same retrieval: snooker 'John Higgins v Jak Jones Today 08:00' matches the official 12:00 UTC start (i.e. US Eastern); greyhound race '11:14 Kinsley' is listed as 06:14 (also US Eastern); but NHL 'PHI Flyers @ BUF Sabres Tomorrow 00:37' cannot be US Eastern, because the official puck-drop is 21 October 19:30 ET. Listed times are therefore recorded as strings only, and no scheduled start in this dataset is derived from them. Where an official start was verified it is stored separately in the 'start' field.

items.title: Same golf tournament shows two different dates/times on OLBG
items.detail: The golf sport page lists 'Genesis Championship — 25 Oct 04:00'. The all-sports page, retrieved minutes earlier, listed the same tournament as 'Tomorrow 02:10'. The official DP World Tour page gives 22-25 October 2026. Only the official dates are published; the OLBG labels are kept verbatim as raw strings.

items.title: NHL fixture labelled 'Tomorrow 00:37' by OLBG; official start is the previous evening
items.detail: OLBG shows PHI Flyers @ BUF Sabres as 'Tomorrow 00:37'. The official start is Wednesday 21 October 2026, 19:30 ET at KeyBank Center. Published start = official time; OLBG label retained as raw text. Same pattern for FLA Panthers @ OTT Senators, whose official start was not independently verified, so that row keeps only the OLBG label.

sources.label: CBS Sports — Sabres vs Flyers, BUF -185, KeyBank Center

items.title: Genesis Championship course par reported as both 71 and 72
items.detail: One preview says 'par-72 course, 7,367 yards', while SBS and the Racing Post say par 71 over 7,367 yards. The official DP World Tour pages retrieved do not state the par. Par is therefore left blank in the dataset rather than picking a side.

sources.label: SBS News — 'Woo Jeong Hills Country Club (par 71)'
DP World Tour — Genesis Championship 2026 (official page, par not stated)

items.title: Competition name missing for most domestic fixtures
items.detail: OLBG's tennis, cricket, rugby union, volleyball, handball and greyhound listings show no competition name in the row (the URL only says All_Events). Competition is left blank with competition_status='not_stated_by_source'. Guessing a league from team names was deliberately rejected.
affected_rows: all rows where competition is null

sources.label: OLBG — Rugby Union tips (no competition column)

items.title: Three rows were truncated at the page boundary; their tip counts are blank
items.detail: The retrieved text for Ekaterina Alexandrova v Marta Kostyuk, La Rochelle v Bordeaux and Novara W v Marignano W was cut off mid-row. Tip counts and percentages are null for these, and no probability or price is originated for them. They are kept in the dataset so the coverage list stays complete.

items.title: Coverage is the first page of each sport, not the full OLBG card
items.detail: Every sport page paginates behind a 'Load More Tips' control. Only the rows rendered on the first page were captured (137 rows across 15 sports). Fixtures beyond that are not in this dataset, so absence from this list must not be read as 'not happening'.

items.title: Four handball fixtures have 'Tie' as the most-tipped selection
items.detail: Aalborg v RK Celje, HC Kriens Luzern v KS Kielce, Kolstad v SC Magdeburg and Sporting CP v IK Kristianstad all show the draw as the OLBG consensus. This confirms a three-way market. Our model originates two-way money lines, so the pick is the home side and the draw price is not published.

items.title: Tennis consensus is sometimes not the match winner
items.detail: Zangar Nurlanuly v Tomas Machac shows a '1st Set Winner' consensus, and Bellucci v Etcheverry, Diaz Acosta v Basilashvili and Damm v Cerundolo show 'Set Betting' consensus. None of these is a match-winner pick, so our match probability for those four is originated from the home/away edge only and labelled low confidence.

items.title: Ninety-plus rows are carried by tiny tip samples
items.detail: Many fixtures have one, two or three tips. A 100% confidence figure on a single tip is not evidence, so those rows are capped at low confidence and carry the 'small_sample_lt5_tips' flag. Confidence percentages were copied from OLBG and never recomputed.

sources.label: OLBG — Betting tips (tip counts as published)

items.title: Our handicap and total lines are model assumptions, not market data
items.detail: No bookmaker prices appear in the OLBG pages we retrieved, so handicap and total lines are generated from sport-level dispersion and mean assumptions documented in data/model.md. They are our own lines, which is what was asked for, but they are not verified market quotes and should not be read as such.

items.title: Outright markets have no head-to-head line
items.detail: Golf tournaments, the F1 drivers' championship, the All-Ireland 2027 market, Rugby League futures and greyhound races have fields whose size is not published on the retrieved pages. No price is originated for these; the OLBG consensus selection is shown for reference only and confidence is low.

items.title: Sandbox could not reach OLBG with a normal HTTP client
items.detail: curl to https://www.olbg.com/ returns OpenSSL SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL (exit 35); the same is true for espn.com and bbc.co.uk in this environment. All OLBG pages were therefore retrieved with the agent's page-retrieval tool and transcribed by hand, with the retrieval timestamp stored on every row. A future run with direct HTTP access should re-harvest and diff.

items.title: Only one baseball fixture exists and Rugby League has fixtures only in 2027
items.detail: Baseball returned a single fixture (World Series Game 1) and the Rugby League page listed only outright futures for 2027, no upcoming matches. That is a property of the source at retrieval time, not a gap in the harvest.

items.title: URC venue named two ways for two fixtures
items.detail: For Stormers v Scarlets and Leinster v Munster the sources disagree on venue: the URC/BBC listings give 'Aviva Stadium' and 'DHL Stadium' in some places and 'Laya Arena' and 'Cape Town Stadium' in others. Venue is therefore left blank for those two rows; competition and kick-off time are agreed by all sources and are published.

items.title: Only two handball fixtures could be tied to a competition
items.detail: The EHF Champions League round-5 window (21-22 October 2026) is confirmed, and Zagreb v PSG is confirmed fixture-by-fixture by the EHF club page. The other thirteen handball rows are domestic or cross-border fixtures whose competition is not named by OLBG and could not be confirmed fixture-by-fixture in this pass, so they stay blank.

sources.label: EHF Champions League — Paris Saint-Germain club page (official)

items.title: Afghanistan v Bangladesh ODI venue is stated differently by different fixtures boards
items.detail: The 21 October tri-series ODI is confirmed by the ICC's own announcement (21 October: Afghanistan v Bangladesh) and by ESPNcricinfo's fixtures board (3rd Match, UAE ODI Tri-Series, 11:30 GMT). The VENUE, however, is disputed: several fixtures boards list Abu Dhabi (Sheikh Zayed), while other listings and the cricinfo live page say Sharjah Cricket Stadium (where the final is also scheduled). The venue field is left blank rather than guessing.

items.title: Australia Women v New Zealand Women 3rd T20I: venue named two ways
items.detail: ESPNcricinfo and ESPN both list the 3rd T20I at North Sydney Oval on 22 October. One fixtures board (CricketWorld) lists Junction Oval, Melbourne instead. The row records North Sydney (majority source) and flags the conflict for manual review. Kick-off is 19:15 local per ESPNcricinfo.

sources.label: ESPN series page - NZ Women tour of Australia

items.title: Namibia v Ireland ground named two ways in Windhoek
items.detail: The 1st ODI on 22 October is confirmed by ESPNcricinfo and BBC Sport. The ground is called 'High Performance Oval' by some boards and 'Namibia Cricket Ground' by others (same Windhoek complex). City recorded; ground naming flagged.

sources.label: BBC Sport - Ireland in Namibia 2026 fixtures

items.title: Re-audit finding on FL-002: OLBG time labels behave like US Eastern
items.detail: Session-074739aa's line-by-line pass compared 40+ OLBG time labels with official start times. Labels sit exactly 6 hours behind France (CET/CEST), 4 hours behind GMT, and match US Eastern clock times for the NHL/NBA/cricket rows (e.g. cricinfo's 11:30 GMT AFG-BAN start is labelled 07:30 on OLBG). The residual oddities (19:10, 19:37, 00:37) look like TV windows or a separate rounding artefact. This does not resolve FL-002 completely - OLBG still publishes no timezone - but the working interpretation is 'US Eastern'. All verified_start values in data/matches.json are the OFFICIAL local times, never OLBG's labels.

items.title: 36 rows remain unverified after the 2026-10-21 re-audit; fields left blank by policy
items.detail: The re-audit confirmed 101 of 137 rows against official or primary sources. The remaining 36 could not be tied to an official schedule in this pass and keep blank competition/venue/start fields exactly as published: handball domestic (Sandefjord-Runar, Hallby-Savehof, Hammarby-Alingsas, Mors Thy-Bjerringbro), volleyball (Serie A1 x3, Dutch, Finnish, PlusLiga x4 incl. Jelcz-Stal Nysa, Slepsk-GKS, Skra-Projekt, Chelm-Resovia, Bundesliga Karlsruhe-Luneburg), basketball AEK-Antwerp Giants (EuroCup slate not confirmed for this pairing), ICE HL HCB Sudtirol-Innsbruck, golf (Players Series SA, Senior Italian Open, Fortinet Players Cup, Hong Kong Open, Stella Artois Players Championship), all 5 Gaelic football rows (see FL-001), all 6 greyhound rows (daily race cards; no official racecard retrieved), and the 3 Rugby League outright markets. None of these rows were guessed or filled in.

items.title: Four rows are verified from corroborating listings only (official page not retrieved)
items.detail: These rows passed multi-source corroboration but the governing body's own page could not be retrieved from this sandbox: Seoul Thunders v KCC Egis (KBL; live-basketball schedule listing), Netzhoppers KW v Helios Grizzlys Giesen (21.10. 19:00; German public-broadcaster league schedule + VfB fixture grid), Stifel Charity Classic (PGA Tour Champions; AP week preview), Hero Women's Indian Open (Ladies European Tour; published LET calendar). They are marked verified_secondary_only in data/verifications.json so a reviewer can spot-check them first.
